messages:
riley: Quick sync — SDK/Proxy owners: two small blockers before we flip v2 as the default for /generate + /chat. TL;DR: (1) telemetry header loss through api-shim, (2) streamed function-calls can drop final delta chunk. Can owners ack and say who will own fixes?

jamie: Which telemetry fields are missing? I saw a spike of 'unknown_client' in staging logs yesterday.

riley: client_id and model_version are the ones being stripped when requests go through the legacy proxy. Repro (staging):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'X-Client-Id: sdk-123' -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://staging.proxy.redwood/api/v2/generate
```
Response hits backend without X-Client-Id header.

ben: I can take the shim change — will update forward logic to preserve X-Client-Id and X-Model-Ver. Plan: patch + unit tests today, canary to 10% Tue. @sarah can you hold perf smoke?

sarah: yep. Tue 10:00 PT slot works. I'll run the usual p50/p90/p99 and token-throughput checks. Reminder from last canary: p99 +15ms on one node due to bad batching fallback.

mike: Can we gate the change behind a runtime flag? Suggest flag name: api.v2.forward_client_headers so we can flip quickly. Also SDK team: are we going to start sending X-Model-Ver?

jamie: SDK will add X-Model-Ver in v3.2.0 (target Wed). We can keep older SDKs supported for 14 days while shim backfills. We'll publish a short migration note in the SDK changelog.

ben: shim will backfill missing headers for 14 days. I'll add the runtime flag and default it off in prod until canary looks good. Also adding integration test to verify streaming preserves final function-call chunk.

riley: Awesome. Action items: ben = shim forward + flag + tests (ETA EOD today), jamie = SDK v3.2.0 PR with header and changelog (ETA Wed), sarah = perf smoke (Tue 10:00 PT), mike = hold rollback playbook + monitor dashboards. I'll update the rollout doc once canary passes.

jamie: small ask — can we include a short fallback header for older proxies? like X-Client:legacy. Some customers still route through the old hop.

ben: good call. I'll map X-Client and X-Client-Id -> X-Client-Id in the shim.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for proxy-shim (ref: ci/pipe#9812) -> 2024-12-10T17:00:00Z, target 10% traffic, rollback window 30m.

sarah: noted. I'll have perf dashboards open and a script for quick p99 snapshots.

mike: pinging infra on increased logging for the first 30m of the canary (just header-presence metrics). cc @infra oncall.

riley: Thanks all. If anything blocks, drop a quick note here. Otherwise I'll mark owners in the rollout doc and proceed with canary. :thumbsup:
